name: 三界神话完整加强版
english_name: Myth of the Three Realms: Enhanced Complete Edition (Quanzhou)
english_description: The fifth and final build in the "Myth of the Three Realms" series (see also sjsh, sjshv150, sjshv2578bb, and sjshwzb) — an enhanced edition sharing sjshwzb's Quanzhou map, sect roster (including the exclusive Shaolin/Emei/Kunlun additions and the Asura/Demon-Realm/Sky-Realm mythology zones), and core system files almost exactly (99%+ of shared-path files are byte-identical). The starting Southern-City Inn is fully populated: a message board, a gift-giving NPC (☆小宁宁☆), an innkeeper, and a postman ("Farsighted Eye," d/ourhome/npc/bigeye.lpc) hinting at a mail system. A live death-to-revival playthrough is confirmed working end to end: killing a mob on Vermilion Bird Street sends the player to Judge Cui Jue in the Yin-Yang Realm before respawning at the inn. The main operational difference from sjshwzb is that its wizlist started empty rather than pre-seeded; this build's own port of the sjshwzb Emei-Huayanding fix additionally caught a case-mismatch false-negative in carry_object()'s existence check that had been crashing every single new-character registration via the inn's postman NPC — fixed here and backported to sjshwzb.
